roleContext.jobDescription: The bank's model validation function reviews the credit and market risk models before they are approved for use. The Senior Quantitative Analyst is the senior reviewer on validation reviews: signs the validation report as the senior reviewer, sets the validation scope with the model owners, supervises the associate-grade reviewers on the review, presents findings to the model risk committee, and documents review boundaries. The function requires prior experience as the senior reviewer of record on validation reviews, not as a second reviewer. Reports to the head of model validation; works with the model owners, the associate reviewers and the model risk committee secretariat.

requirements.text: Has been the senior reviewer of record on validation reviews, signing the validation report as senior reviewer.
Sets the validation scope with the model owners and supervises the associate-grade reviewers on the review.
Presents validation findings to the model risk committee.
Performs validation testing on credit risk models under a documented validation standard.
Documents review boundaries and open items in the validation report.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Senior Quantitative Analyst, Model Validation

## Experience

- Quantitative Analyst, associate grade, in the model validation function of a retail bank for three years, working as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record.
- Performed the validation testing on those reviews under the bank's validation standard: replication of the model estimates, benchmark model comparison and stability testing, with the test workbooks filed in the validation repository.
- Drafted the findings sections and the open items list of the validation reports, which the reviewer of record edited and signed; attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four of the reviews.
- Kept the review boundary section of each report current and maintained the validation function's testing template after the 2024 standard update.
- Before the bank, one year as a graduate analyst in a consultancy's risk practice.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the test workbook and the drafted findings section for one credit risk model validation, with the validation repository references as a verification trail; the signed report carries the reviewer of record's signature.
